system.description:
The world of money and business awaits your whim. You understand interest, stocks, currency exchange and GNPs, and can balance books, follow a money trail, perform an audit or run a business of your own.

Most uses call for a Mental Challenge (difficulty by task). Alternately, you can expend a level of Finance between games to raise $250 in cash — not every use is so benign, as money laundering has to come from somewhere.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Character Creation and Traits
